chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: I can confirm Charlie's observation since Mona and I were in Upper Engine together for several rounds, so Mona, can you verify that?
chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Since Mona hasn't spoken yet, let's wait for her to confirm Doraemon's story about Upper Engine before we make any decisions.
Discussion: [System]: You have 3 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote

chat: Discussion: [Liam]: I can vouch for both Mona and Doraemon because I was with them in Medbay and saw them both performing tasks in Upper Engine, including Mona's scan and Doraemon's compression coil.
chat: Discussion: [Ian]: I can vouch for Alice and Oscar since we were together in Admin and Electrical, and I also saw Eren completing tasks in Electrical and Lower Engine.

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: I can confirm Ian's account since we were together in Electrical and Lower Engine, but I'm curious about Liam's vouch because I saw him in Lower Engine doing the catalyzer task recently, which contradicts him being with Mona and Doraemon in Upper Engine.

chat: Discussion: [Mona]: I can confirm that Doraemon and I were together in Upper Engine, and I actually saw Liam performing the compression coil and catalyzer tasks there, so Eren, are you sure it was Liam you saw in Lower Engine?

chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: Since Eren and Mona are giving completely contradictory reports about Liam's location, I suggest we skip this vote and gather more information to avoid accidentally ejecting a crewmate.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: I agree with Kevin to skip this vote, but since Eren's claim about seeing Liam in Lower Engine completely contradicts Mona, Doraemon, and Liam, we really need to figure out who is lying about his location before we make any moves.

chat: Discussion: [Modi]: [I agree with Kevin to skip this vote since we shouldn't eject anyone based on conflicting alibis without solid proof, and while Eren's contradiction about Liam is definitely worth looking into, I was just moving around Admin and Electrical doing my tasks so I didn't see anything suspicious when Oscar was eliminated, meaning we should use this extra round to cross-check our movements and finish tasks in Weapons before jumping to conclusions.]

chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: I agree with skipping the vote for now as Kevin suggested, but we should keep a very close eye on Eren's movements in the next round since his claim completely contradicts what Mona, Liam, and I all witnessed.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: I agree with Kevin, Charlie, and Modi that we should skip this vote, as it's too risky to act on "he said, she said" contradictions, but I can vouch for Oscar and Ian since I saw them both performing tasks in Admin and Storage.
Discussion: [System]: You have 2 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote

chat: Discussion: [Liam]: I agree with skipping, but let's be clear: I only arrived in Lower Engine in Round 9, so Eren is trying to create a contradiction where there isn't one to cast suspicion on me.

chat: Discussion: [Ian]: I want to clarify that I saw Liam in Lower Engine during Round 10, not Round 9, which might explain the timing confusion, but I still strongly vouch for Eren since I personally saw him resetting breakers and checking the catalyzer.
chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Mona, how could you have seen Liam doing the catalyzer task in Upper Engine when the catalyzer is actually located in Lower Engine?
chat: Discussion: [Mona]: Wait, you're right, I must have mixed up the room names in the heat of the moment, but I definitely saw Liam performing that task with us.
chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: Since Mona just admitted she mixed up the room locations, her vouch for Liam becomes much more suspicious, so we should be very cautious about trusting her alibi.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: I agree with Kevin that Mona's mix-up is a major red flag, so let's all stick to our usual routes and report our exact locations and task progress before the final vote to properly cross-check everyone's alibis.

chat: Discussion: [Modi]: While Mona's admission about mixing up room names is definitely a red flag, Eren's specific timing claim is also hard to ignore, so I agree with Charlie and Kevin that we should stick to skipping this vote and use the remaining rounds to cross-check our exact task locations before I head to Weapons to finish my tasks safely.

chat: Discussion: [Doraemon]: Mona, I know you're just confused about the room names, but saying the catalyzer was in Upper Engine makes it look bad, so we need to be more precise to ensure we don't accidentally eject a crewmate.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: I agree that Mona's mistake is suspicious, but as Kevin and Modi suggested, we should still skip this vote and follow Charlie's plan to report our exact locations and tasks for the last few rounds to see if any other contradictions emerge.
Discussion: [System]: You have 1 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote

chat: Discussion: [Liam]: Mona just got the room names mixed up, but Doraemon can confirm we were actually together in Upper Engine before I moved to Lower Engine in Round 9, and I think we should be wary of how strongly Ian and Eren are vouching for each other.

chat: Discussion: [Ian]: Liam is trying to deflect by questioning my bond with Eren, but I have firsthand knowledge of Eren resetting breakers and checking the catalyzer in Lower Engine, whereas Mona's "mix-up" about the catalyzer being in Upper Engine is a massive red flag since that task only exists in Lower Engine.

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Doraemon, if you were really with Mona and Liam in Upper Engine, why didn't you correct her immediately when she claimed the catalyzer was there, since you're both claiming to be crewmates doing tasks?

chat: Discussion: [Mona]: I didn't correct Doraemon because I was the one who made the mistake and I've already admitted it, but Doraemon and Liam can both confirm we were together regardless of my confusion over the room name, whereas Ian and Eren are vouching for each other far too aggressively.
chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: It's highly suspicious that Doraemon didn't immediately correct Mona's factual error about the catalyzer's location if they were actually standing right there together.
